items.t: Intake manifold gasket coolant leak
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: If coolant got into the oil or the engine overheated, expect much more.

items.t: Ignition can be bumped out of Run (recall 14V-400)
items.job: Install ignition key insert or key cover (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Steering rack bearing retainer can fail (recall 03V-527)
items.job: Install new steering gear lower pinion bearing
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN. If the steering gear must be replaced, expect more.

items.t: Passlock anti-theft no-start
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder and Passlock sensor
items.note: Some shops use a bypass module instead, which can cost less.

items.t: Accelerator pedal can stick in heat (recall 04V-528)
items.job: Replace accelerator and brake pedal assembly
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Electric power steering assist cuts out (recalls 14V-153 and 15V-064)
items.job: Replace power steering motor, torque sensor or controller
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Shift cable can break or come loose (recalls)
items.job: Replace shift cable and bracket
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Brake lights and stability control fault from body module connector (recall 14V-252)
items.job: Secure body module connector and relearn brake pedal position
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: 6-speed automatic loses 3rd, 5th and Reverse
items.job: Replace 3-5-Reverse wave plate (transmission overhaul)
items.note: If debris damaged other parts and the transmission must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Oil burning and timing chain stretch
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner (2.4L)
items.note: If piston rings must be replaced to stop oil burning, expect much more.

items.t: Low-beam headlights stop working
items.job: Repair burnt headlight connector and wiring
items.note: Price is per side. If the body control module is at fault, expect more.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall 19V-019)
items.job: Replace driver front airbag module
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Front seat belt anchor cable can break (recall 15V-269)
items.job: Replace front seat belt anchor bracket and cable
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Water pump leak or failure
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant (2.5L)
items.note: If the engine overheated, repairs can cost much more.

items.t: Rear toe links can corrode and break (recalls 20V-764, 21V-633)
items.job: Replace rear toe links and adjuster bolts
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall 16V-502)
items.job: Replace ignition key cylinder lock housing
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Brake assist loss with auto stop/start (recall 14V-247)
items.job: Update brake control module software (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Shift cable adjuster can disengage (recall 14V-092)
items.job: Inspect and replace shift cable adjuster
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Engine Power Reduced and loss of power
items.job: Replace electronic throttle body
items.note: Sometimes a software update or wiring repair fixes it instead. Have the codes read first.

items.t: ABS and stability control can shut off (recall 16V-272)
items.job: Replace electronic brake control module
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can come loose (recall 18V-358)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and fuel pipe
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor may be miscalibrated (recall 18V-400)
items.job: Install passenger seat sensor service kit
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Rear seat belt retractor fasteners loose (recall 21V-649)
items.job: Inspect and tighten rear seat belt retractors
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Software can shut off fuel injectors (recall 19V-642)
items.job: Reprogram engine control module (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Transmission fluid leak from stop/start accumulator (recall 20V-668)
items.job: Inspect and replace transmission start/stop accumulator
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN. If the transmission ran low on fluid, damage may cost much more.

items.t: Driver seat tilt weld may be weak (recall 22V-359)
items.job: Replace driver seat cushion frame
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Rearview camera picture distorted or blank (recall 26V-212)
items.job: Inspect and replace rearview camera
items.note: Free under GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Side airbag inflator can rupture (recall 15V-666)
items.job: Replace side impact airbag module
items.note: Free under recall 15V-666 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Sunroof can close by itself when the switch is brushed (recall 15V-164)
items.job: Replace sunroof slide and tilt switch
items.note: Free under recall 15V-164 on affected cars. Check the VIN first.
